questions.stem: 當網紅已被許多青少年視為快速成名致富的方法。
questions.answer: Becoming an Internet celebrity has been regarded by many teenagers as a quick way to fame and fortune.
accepted_answers: Being an online celebrity has been seen by many teenagers as a fast way to become rich and famous.
Becoming an influencer has been viewed by many teens as a quick way to get famous and rich.

questions.stem: 不過，他們應該先想清楚要拍什麼內容，以及如何面對負面留言。
questions.answer: However, they should first think carefully about what videos to make and how to deal with negative comments.
accepted_answers: However, they should first figure out what kind of videos to make and how to handle negative comments.
But they should first think clearly about what to film and how to face negative comments.

1.explanation_zh: 主詞「當網紅」是動詞片語，英文改成動名詞 Becoming an Internet celebrity（網紅也可說 influencer）。「已被…視為…」用完成式被動加 regard A as B：has been regarded by many teenagers as …（regarded 也可換成 seen／viewed，as 不能省）。「成名致富」可以用名詞 fame and fortune，或寫成 to become rich and famous；不要寫成 to famous and rich。
1.strategy_zh: 「A 被 B 視為 C」→ A + be regarded/seen/viewed + by B + as C；先確認主詞是不是動作，是動作就改成 V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：當網紅／已被許多青少年視為／快速／成名致富
標的詞彙：celebrity（名人、網紅，L5）、regard（視為，L2）、teenager（青少年，L1）、quick（快速的，L1）、fame（名聲，L4）、fortune（財富，L3）
句型框架：V-ing … + has been regarded by + N + as + N

2.explanation_zh: 「應該」用 should + 原形動詞；「先」是 first，放在 should 後面。「要拍什麼內容」「如何面對」都是「疑問詞＋不定詞」：what videos to make、how to deal with …，兩個用 and 連接；think 後面要接 about。「面對」負面留言可以用 deal with／handle／face（face 後面不加 with）。
2.strategy_zh: 「該做什麼／如何做」當受詞時，想 what to VR、how to VR；兩個並列時都用同樣的形式。
hints: 切成四段：不過，他們應該先／想清楚要拍什麼內容／以及如何面對／負面留言
標的詞彙：should（應該，L1）、think（想，L1）、video（影片、內容，L1）、deal with（面對、處理，L1）、negative（負面的，L2）、comment（留言，L4）
句型框架：S + should first + think about + what + N + to VR … and how to VR …

celebrity 是可數名詞，單數前面要加 an。

common_errors.explanation_zh: regard A as B 的 as 不能換成 to；「已被」用現在完成式被動。

way to 的 to 後面接名詞（fame and fortune）或原形動詞（become famous and rich），不能直接接形容詞。
become 後面接形容詞 famous、rich；fame、fortune 是名詞。

traps.literal_error: Become an Internet celebrity has been regarded by many teenagers as a quick way to fame and fortune.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文主詞是動詞片語「當網紅」，照字面寫 Become … 不合文法；要改成動名詞 Becoming …。

traps.literal_error: Becoming an Internet celebrity has been regarded by many teenagers as a quick way to famous and rich.
traps.explanation_zh: a way to 後面要接名詞或原形動詞；famous、rich 是形容詞，要寫 fame and fortune 或 to become rich and famous。

1.restructuring_zh: 「當網紅」是動詞片語當主詞，英文要寫成動名詞 Becoming an Internet celebrity；「已被許多青少年視為…」改成完成式被動 has been regarded by many teenagers as …。

traps.literal_error: However, they should first think about what videos should make and how to deal with negative comments.
traps.explanation_zh: 「要拍什麼」中文沒寫主詞，照字面寫 what … should make 少了主詞；用 what videos to make（或 what videos they should make）。

traps.literal_error: However, they should first think carefully about what videos to make and how to face with negative comments.
traps.explanation_zh: 「面對」照字面寫 face with 是錯的搭配；用 deal with、handle，或直接 face + 受詞。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[1]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: Becoming an Internet celebrity has been regarded by many teenagers as a way to get rich and famous quickly.
1.explanation_zh: 「當網紅」用動名詞 Becoming… 當主詞；「已被…視為」用現在完成被動 has been regarded as（be seen as 亦可）；「快速成名致富的方法」譯 a way to get rich and famous quickly。「網紅」譯 Internet celebrity（influencer 亦可）。

2.translation: However, they should first think carefully about what content to film and how to deal with negative comments.
2.explanation_zh: 「想清楚要拍什麼內容，以及如何面對…」用兩個 wh- + to V（what content to film、how to deal with）當 about 的受詞，等於名詞子句的減化；「面對負面留言」譯 deal with negative comments（handle 亦可）。

issues_zh: 「快速成名致富的方法」的「快速」是修飾「成名致富」的副詞，我自然譯成 a way to get rich and famous quickly；P3「快速」只收 a quick way 這類形容詞寫法，P3／P4 的切法預設了 quick way 的語序，副詞寫法會把「快速」併進 P4，P3 無從給分。
建議 P3 accepted 補 a way to … quickly／a way to quickly become … 的寫法（或把 P3、P4 合併後重切），標的詞 quick 的 alternatives 補 quickly（目前程式比對不到 quickly，所以我沒有把 quick 列進 used_target_words）。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義
第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：「快速成名致富的方法」的「快速」是修飾「成名致富」的副詞，我自然譯成 a way to get rich and famous quickly；P3「快速」只收 a quick way 這類形容詞寫法，P3／P4 的切法預設了 quick

1.translation: Becoming an influencer has been regarded by many teenagers as a quick way to get famous and rich.
1.explanation_zh: 「當網紅」是動作，用動名詞 Becoming an influencer 當主詞；「已被……視為」用現在完成被動 has been regarded…as；「快速成名致富的方法」用 a quick way to get famous and rich。

2.translation: However, they should first figure out what content to film and how to deal with negative comments.
2.explanation_zh: 「不過」用 However；「應該先想清楚」用 should first figure out；「要拍什麼內容，以及如何面對負面留言」用疑問詞加不定詞並列 what content to film and how to deal with…。
